experiments.description: CFFQNN classification experiment on the balanced credit card fraud detection dataset using a 3-2-1 layer structure and Qiskit statevector simulation.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: iterated until parameters converge; no explicit threshold reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Seven PCA-reduced features are encoded into three qubits by applying Ry(sum_i Xi Wi + b) to each of the first three qubits; subsequent hidden layers use controlled-Ry gates between adjacent layers.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary classification of credit card transactions as fraudulent or not fraudulent.

problem_instance.description: Credit card fraud detection classification on a balanced dataset.

dataset_specification.description: Kaggle dataset; original 30 features reduced to 7 principal components using PCA; class imbalance addressed by removing excess class instances to balance the dataset; split into 688 training and 296 testing samples.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: PCA to 7 features; class balancing by removing excess class instances.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Final qubit expectation value <Z_N> passed through a classical nonlinear function to produce binary class label.

speedup_claims.conditions: for the proposed cffqnn architecture compared with standard qnn baselines
speedup_claims.caveats: The paper reports relative reduction but does not provide the exact baseline depth in the main text for this experiment.
